_readme: Markets served. Distributors do not buy a grade, they buy for a customer,
so this is the index the rest of the catalogue hangs off: which grade and
which pack format each market takes, and what the material does there.
`function` is what the aragonite does in that application. Keep it factual.
No agronomic rate recommendations and no pH guarantees: aragonite raises
and buffers alkalinity, it does not hold a value.
`status` is 'served' for markets currently supplied in bagged or bulk form,
'enquire' for ones quoted case by case. Anything marked TODO needs a real
answer from the plant before launch.

markets.name: Aquarium and aquaculture
markets.buyers: Pet and aquatic distributors, aquarium retail chains, aquaculture supply
markets.summary: Substrate for marine, reef and hard-water freshwater systems, and a carbonate source in aquaculture.
markets.function: Provides a carbonate substrate that supports alkalinity in systems drawing it down, and a grain size matched to livestock and flow.
markets.notes: The only market taking the printed 20 lb retail bag.

markets.name: Agriculture and soil
markets.buyers: Ag retail, soil amendment blenders, organic input distributors
markets.summary: A calcium carbonate soil amendment supplied in bulk bags and by the ton.
markets.function: Supplies calcium and carbonate to soil. Aragonite is softer and more reactive than calcitic limestone at the same particle size.
markets.notes: TODO: confirm OMRI listing status for these grades before publishing any organic-production claim.

markets.name: Animal feed
markets.buyers: Feed mills, mineral pre-mix blenders, livestock supply distributors
markets.summary: A calcium carbonate source for feed and mineral blending, in bulk bags and by the ton.
markets.function: Supplies dietary calcium as carbonate. Sized for blending and for free-choice mineral feeding.
markets.notes: TODO: confirm feed-grade qualification, heavy-metal testing scope and any state feed registrations before supplying this market.

markets.name: Turf and horticulture
markets.buyers: Turf supply distributors, golf and sports-field contractors, growing-media blenders
markets.summary: A carbonate amendment and top-dressing component for sand-based rootzones and growing media.
markets.function: Adds calcium carbonate to sand rootzones and potting media without the fines that impede drainage.

markets.name: Water treatment
markets.buyers: Water treatment media distributors, system integrators
markets.summary: A carbonate contact media for remineralisation and alkalinity recovery. Quoted per application.
markets.function: Dissolves into low-alkalinity water passing through it, raising hardness and buffering capacity.
markets.notes: TODO: confirm NSF/ANSI 61 status before supplying potable-water applications.
